I’ve excluded commission-heavy sales jobs unless they’re truly low-stress, and skipped fields that require years of prior experience (like aviation).

### **1. Real Estate Broker**
**Pay:** **$60,000–$150,000+** (U.S. medians) — **$70k–$120k/year** after 2–3 years with a book of clients [8][2].
**Time to entry:** **3–6 months** (varies by state). You’ll need a **real estate agent license** (~$200–$400 for course + exam) and **pre-licensing education** (~60–150 hours). **Why?** No degree, no boss — you set your own hours, but success hinges on networking and local market knowledge. **Fastest no-degree path to $100k/year** if you hustle [2][8].
